title: 3.13 Phone Number and Address
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Say zero, give a phone number digit by digit, and give an address with a house number.
grammar_function: What is your phone number? It is + digits; What is your address? It is + house number + Park Street; My address is + house number + Park Street; It is number zero.
prerequisite: 2.1 park; 2.2 street; 2.6-2.7 numbers and What number is it?; 3.1 What is your name?; 3.5-3.6 twelve to twenty; 3.10 my, your.
speaking_outcome: Ask What is your phone number? and What is your address?, and answer with a number and with a house number on Park Street.
